verdict.rationale: A relay or edge proxy is a fair question for a feature-flag platform, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions a self-hostable relay, edge proxy, or forward-proxy component for Statsig. What it does show is adjacent: SDK-side caching, on-device evaluation and local evaluation after initialization. These are SDK resilience features, not a deployable proxy that keeps SDK traffic inside the customer's network, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can run a relay/edge proxy so flags stay served when the vendor is unreachable and SDK traffic stays inside my network
